description: Shared-symbol-endpoint PAM4; original independent-lane offsets removed deliberately; no channel, timing jitter or additive sample noise.

model_settings.model: shared symbol-center endpoints; normalized logistic segments
model_settings.transition_duration_convention: 10-90 of endpoint-normalized L(u); solved for kappa unless explicitly supplied
model_settings.alignment: endpoints at symbol centers (k+0.5) UI; boundaries at integer UI; no crossing recentering
model_settings.valid_interval_kind: first through last symbol center, inclusive; no artificial endpoint guards
model_settings.rng: SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3): symbols, endpoint fluctuations, reserved additive noise
model_settings.analytic_reference: pre-impairment independent endpoint fluctuations; channel and additive noise disabled
model_settings.segment_dependence: adjacent segments share endpoints and are correlated
model_settings.continuity: amplitude continuity only; derivatives need not agree at joins
model_settings.validation_tolerances: 6 standard errors; lane n_eff=n/2 conservatively accounts for adjacent endpoint sharing

eye_alignment: start_k = b_k - 0.5*T + display_phase_ui*T; nominal boundary at 0.5-phase UI

rendering.density_line_underlay: first 500 source traces; display only; not histogram counts
